rationale: No such request has been reported as of Aug 15; AIPAC has declined to back the nominee in Texas and Paxton an America First critic is the GOP Senate candidate most at odds with AIPAC (San Antonio Express-News, Jul 22), with AIPAC pivoting to Rogers against El-Sayed (Middle East Eye, Aug 5).

Bruno Fernandes, the FWA Footballer of the Year with a record 21 assists, is widely reported as PFA winner (OneFootball May 24 'Bruno Fernandes named PFA Player of the Year') and Polymarket prices him ~81% before the Aug 25 ceremony (thepfa.com shortlist, Jun 4).

Djokovic/Sabalenka are the top seed but the event is a best-of-3, four-game-set knockout with 16 teams (Yahoo Jul 27, AP), so the strongest rival pairs - Rybakina/Fritz, Swiatek/Ruud and two-time champions Errani/Vavassori - each have meaningful elimination odds.

Russian state media (Aug 9-11) report Witkoff and Kushner may travel to Kyiv and Moscow this month; CBS has repeatedly covered Witkoff's Moscow trips, making him the most likely single named official, with Kushner the co-traveler.

No US measles deaths through mid-August 2026 (CNHI Aug 14, citing CDC 2,556 cases); largest clusters are South Carolina, Utah and Arizona (Medical Daily Aug 4), while Pennsylvania's outbreak is growing fastest (296 cases, Lancaster) going into the school year.

King Harald V (89) remains reigning; palace said his Aug 7 Rikshospitalet visit was a planned checkup and he carried out Council of State duties that day (VG, Aug 7), so abdication/death before Aug 29 is unlikely.

Abbas and ex-Yesh Atid MK Yoav Segalovitz confirmed on Aug 13 talks on him joining Ra'am's slate, with reports he intends to take the No. 2 spot (Times of Israel, Haaretz); the deal still needs final signature before Sept 5.

Official PL schedule confirms Aston Villa v Arsenal at Villa Park on Monday 31 Aug; Arsenal are title favourites (6/4) but Villa beat them at home in recent seasons and a tactical preview (Aug 11) predicts a 1-1 draw.

Chelsea completed a £117m (€138m) deal for Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa, currently the biggest PL-club fee ahead of Anderson's £116m (€135m) to Man City (BBC Jul 21, FootballTransfers Aug 8, TransferNews Aug 3); only a late £120m+ deadline-day deal would overtake Rogers.

Queiroz extension talks collapsed over $150k/month demands and the GFA is searching for a new coach (Pulse Ghana, SportsWorldGhana Aug 13-14), with assistant Desmond Ofei the leading internal candidate despite fan backlash (GhanaWeb Aug 14) as AFCON qualifiers start Sep 23.

Smotrich and Ben-Gvir push mass displacement but the far-right is focused on blocking Trump's Board of Peace roadmap in the run-up to the Oct 27 election (JPost Aug 14), so a formally named removal plan in Sept 1-7 is unlikely.

In July cereals +3.4% (wheat +5.8%) led, sugar +5.6% and vegetable oils +2.0% (highest since 2022) with meat -2.8% and dairy -0.7% (FAO, Aug 7 release); Black Sea grain disruption continues, but sharp July sugar/vegetable-oil gains may partially reverse in August.

El Nino-driven Indonesian fires (West/Central Kalimantan) sent haze into Sarawak, where Serian hit API 204 'very unhealthy' and schools closed (Malay Mail/BBC/Mongabay, Aug 12-15); Indonesia has the broader emergency precedent while Malaysia is closest to a Sarawak-level emergency.

Betis host Real Madrid on Friday Sep 4 at La Cartuja (realmadrid.com Aug 3); Mbappe is heavy top-scorer favorite (Stake 1.57) under Mourinho and Real's dominant attack makes a Madrid opener far more likely than a Betis one (Isco/Betis ~8% combined).

OFAC's 8th Iran shadow-banking action (Aug 7) named Shahr Bank and Dubai exchanges (CBS, Mondaq); if a bank is named in the Aug 31-Sep 6 window, established targets like Shahr Bank or Tejarat (sanctioned as part of Nov 2025 network) are most plausible, but no specific bank designation is flagged.

Opta gives Barcelona 45.6% title odds vs Real Madrid 31% (FotMob/Al Jazeera Aug 10-13); after four matchdays Barcelona face Valencia away on Sep 20 while Mourinho's Madrid face the Madrid derby at Atletico on Sep 20, so a Real slip is plausible.

WHO says the outbreak began in Ituri and has spread to five transmission zones, now a sixth province (Bas-Uele) via a case from Haut-Uele (Al Jazeera/Arab News Aug 13, NDTV Aug 9); Ituri remains the epicenter but Haut-Uele is the fastest-growing spillover.

Liverpool are in talks with Standard Chartered (deal to 2026-27, ~£50m/yr) and other partners, with CCO Latty saying 'we'll probably find out pretty soon' (The Athletic via DaveOCKOP Aug 7); Borson rules out Amazon despite Bezos joining the consortium (Football Insider Aug 14).

STF minister Andre Mendonca opened a procedure into PF chief Andrei Rodrigues over the INSS/Lulinha case and banned info-sharing with superiors (Veja Jul 31, G1 Aug 7), but there is no suspension motion and 27 PF superintendents publicly backed Rodrigues (Aug 6).

Third Test at Edgbaston starts Sep 9 with seam-friendly conditions; England's pace attack is Archer/Atkinson/Carse/Tongue (Archer in first two Tests, per Rajasthan Royals Aug 6) and Bashir is likely spinner, so no bowler dominates.
